description: List the background scenes available for car photos: built-in studios, showrooms and outdoor settings, plus the workspace's own custom backgrounds (`custom: true`, made with create_background or in the app). Call this first to pick a scene: each entry has a preview image, an example with a car, and the `id` that generate_background takes as `background_id` (custom ones also go to refine_background and delete_background). Read-only and free; takes no parameters and returns every scene in one response. For logos use list_logos instead.
name: list_backgrounds
title: List backgrounds
